scope: execution, saving, resuming and resource control only. No change to conditions, L, seeds, replicates, evaluation or decision rules (PREREG hash unchanged).

incident.what: first execution (8 processes: Phase 3 A/B/C/D + Phase 4 L20/L50 x A/D in parallel) was stopped by Claude Code after ~1,000 s because the system was critically low on memory; stage outputs were written only at the end, so nothing was saved
incident.measured_cause: OpenBLAS without a thread limit (12 threads/process here): private memory 811 MB per process vs 104 MB with 1 thread (RSS ~110 MB either way); 8 processes x ~0.8 GB committed plus 96 BLAS threads on 6 cores
incident.thread_limit_effect: one Phase 3 fit (A rep1 K5 s1) with 1 vs 12 threads: identical C_Q_L80 and drift_share (bitwise), 31.5 s vs 31.6 s
incident.old_dirs: the 8 empty stage directories phase3_*/phase4_* (0 files each) are kept as a record and not used

changes.runner: tools/research_audit/run_mcem_noise_separation_v2.py (orchestration only); per-fit computation is still run_mcem_noise_separation.phase3_fit / phase4_fit
code_changes_in_compute_module: probe() additionally returns eval_chains, G_onestep, w0_onestep, w_onestep for persistence (no computation or RNG change)
phase3_fit() additionally stores theta_F per probe checkpoint
the Phase 4 per-fit body moved verbatim into phase4_fit() (same seeds, fit_id, tags, order)
changes.persistence: results/<stage>/fits/<fit_key>/{csv, manifest.json} + artifacts/<stage>/<fit_key>.npz; temp file + fsync + os.replace; manifest last with sha256 of every file, config hash (prereg, code hash of the compute files, spec incl. seed/K/start/L/max_iter, input data hashes, thread vars), status, seconds, peak RSS
changes.validation_on_resume: OK/FAILED with matching config hash and checksums are skipped (FAILED never retried or reseeded); anything else INCOMPLETE -> renamed aside (*.incomplete-<time>, never deleted) and rerun from iteration 1 (no mid-fit resume: the MCEM RNG state is not checkpointed)
changes.threads: OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR/VECLIB threads = 1 inside the experiment processes only

resource_rules.memory_guard: before each fit: if available physical memory < 3.0 GB wait (30 s polling) up to 10 min, then stop launching fits (stop_reason LOW_MEMORY, stage PARTIAL); memory logged every 30 s
resource_rules.phase3_parallelism: start with 1 process; increase to at most 3 processes only if the first process's peak RSS < 500 MB and available memory > 6 GB after its first 2 fits; never 4 or more
resource_rules.phase4: only after Phase 3 is completely saved; L=20 first with 1 process; L=50 afterwards with 1 process and no other heavy experiment running
resource_rules.deadline: stop launching new fits after 6 h per stage invocation; unfinished fits stay NOT_RUN and the stage is reported PARTIAL; no condition is dropped after seeing results
resource_rules.user_processes: no other user process is terminated
